editorial.blurb: Jōtō is a sophisticated sushi destination where dry-aged fish—especially their celebrated tuna—shines with meticulous preparation and warm hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the happy hour hand rolls (spicy scallop and salmon avo are standouts) right at opening, or book omakase early for the full dry-aged experience with attentive guidance from staff like Sam and David.
